# STOA — Sovereign iPaaS / iPaaS Souverain

> STOA is a European Sovereign iPaaS with its gateway and control plane,
> integration contracts, API management and MCP capabilities for agents.
> STOA est un iPaaS Souverain européen, avec sa passerelle et son plan de contrôle.

STOA's published code is open source under the Apache 2.0 licence.
Le code publié de STOA est open source, sous licence Apache 2.0

This statement covers only published code. It does not extend to services,
unpublished components, branding or documentation content (CC BY 4.0).
Dependencies retain their own licences.

## Current gateway and target

R1 currently uses the Rust gateway. Envoy is the accepted target data plane;
migration, policy parity and operating validation remain ahead. Do not describe
Envoy as delivered or transfer historical Rust performance claims to Envoy.

## Public repositories

- [stoa](https://github.com/stoa-platform/stoa): primary R1 path in `quickstart/`.
- [stoa-quickstart](https://github.com/stoa-platform/stoa-quickstart): separate path.

Other components are not published.

## Local R1 path — validation in progress

Source review establishes the files and commands, not execution success on a fresh
clone. Image availability and runtime outcomes remain to be validated.

Prerequisites: Git, Docker Engine, Docker Compose (declared minimum 2.1.1, pending
validation), Bash, curl, openssl and GNU timeout for this command sequence.
For macOS supervision alternatives, consult the quickstart README. The control
plane image targets linux/amd64; other architectures may need emulation.
Minimum Engine and CPU/memory/disk resources: [À COMPLÉTER : measured prerequisites].
Public build dependencies need to be reachable. No startup time is guaranteed.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/stoa-platform/stoa.git
cd stoa/quickstart
timeout 300 docker compose up --wait
./verify.sh
```

The timeout value is a declared bound, not a completion-time promise. No environment
file copy, Compose profile or Make command is required by this path.

Services: PostgreSQL, Keycloak, FastAPI control plane, locally built Rust gateway
and mock backend. Neither Console nor Portal nor a broker is included.
The script initializes identity and declares a contract directly on the gateway.
It expects accepted declaration (200 or 201), rejection without a token (401),
rejection with an invalid token (401), success with a Keycloak token (200) and
VERIFY_OK. These outcomes have not been observed here. No specific business
response, control plane publication or MCP path is demonstrated.

Local health endpoints: http://localhost:8000/health and http://localhost:8081/health.
Keycloak base: http://localhost:8080; browser administration is not established by
the published port. The script reads demonstration settings from containers and
generates its call secret. Do not copy sensitive values into documentation.

```bash
docker compose down
# Destructive cleanup of data in affected volumes:
docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans
```

Compose declares no volumes, but third-party images may create them. Inspect and
remove script-created temporary files after diagnosis; [À COMPLÉTER : validated
file inventory and removal procedure]. Do not run other paths on the same ports.

## Envoy responsibilities — target only

The control plane owns UAC contracts and policies. The accepted architecture calls
for compilation to Envoy resources, a dedicated xDS service, durable snapshots,
reconciliation and ACK/NACK tracking. Publication is distinct from effective
application. Envoy handles transport and routing; STOA keeps business decisions
through ext_authz, processing through ext_proc where needed, and MCP/OAuth services.
Wasm requires porting and qualification. An existing service mesh retains its own
configuration authority. Migration needs policy/audience parity, failure checks,
durable recovery and a rehearsed fallback. No delivery date or performance figure
is asserted.

## Website processing

Documentation targets Scaleway Object Storage and Edge Services in Paris, with
Edge logs retained for 7 days and Object Storage access logs disabled. Search runs
locally in the browser using an EN/FR index of docs, blog posts and pages served by
the site; no search query is sent to a third party. Audience analytics are removed.
The privacy policy records unresolved legal details and the theme cookie.
